articles.title: Fossil 'BOB' Reveals a Prehistoric Food Chain: Ichthyosaur Ate Pterosaur, Then Fell Prey to Giant Predator
articles.summary: A 100-million-year-old fossil from Australia's outback captures a rare triple-decker meal: an ichthyosaur swallowed a pterosaur, then was attacked by a massive Kronosaurus. Advanced scans uncovered the hidden evidence.

articles.title: New York's Bodega Cats: Beloved, Illegal, and Now the Stars of a New Book
articles.summary: A new book and advocacy project shines a light on the thousands of cats living in NYC bodegas—technically a health code violation. 'Bodega Cats of New York' features 60 cats and pushes for legal reform.

articles.title: Diablo 4 on Switch 2? Rating Board Leaks Point to a September Release
articles.summary: Multiple rating board listings suggest Blizzard's Diablo 4 is coming to Nintendo Switch 2, potentially on September 15 or 18. The rumored $69.99 release would be a code-in-a-box, not a physical cartridge.
